description: OC81D germanium PNP (Mullard, audio driver), estimated from our OC75 fit: no OC81D sheet

source.licence: Our own estimate (D-186): the values are Solum Builder's

rating_sources.vceo: transistor cross-reference book, page 242 (data/spec-sheets/Germanium_OC_crossref.pdf; datasheetarchive.com DSA841000-11): OC81D row: VCE max 16 V
rating_sources.ic: transistor cross-reference book, page 242 (data/spec-sheets/Germanium_OC_crossref.pdf; datasheetarchive.com DSA841000-11): OC81D row: IC max 10 mA

package.name: X02 (lead code L03, e b c in a line, as the OC75)
package.source: transistor cross-reference book, page 242 (data/spec-sheets/Germanium_OC_crossref.pdf; datasheetarchive.com DSA841000-11): OC81D row: package X02, lead info L03 (the OC75, OC71 and OC44 rows are L03 too)

fit.sheet: no OC81D curve sheet: our OC75 fit (D-184) scaled by the cross-reference book's OC81D row
fit.figure: transistor cross-reference book, page 242 (data/spec-sheets/Germanium_OC_crossref.pdf; datasheetarchive.com DSA841000-11): the OC75 and OC81D rows (hFE min and its bias, Cob max, fT min)
fit.method: .claude/skills/fit-model/worked/germanium/estimate_oc81d.py: the OC75 card with base current x 55/20 (BF x 20/55, ISE x 55/20: hFE min 20 at 5 mA against 55 at 10 mA), CJC x 40/50 (Cob max 40 pF against 50), TF x 1/2 (fT min 200 kHz against 100 kHz); VBE, leakage, VAF and RE kept
fit.note: Estimated, not fitted: no OC81D sheet with curves was found, so this is the OC75's shape at the OC81D's lower gain. Give a measured hFE and leakage (D-130).

datasheet.source: transistor cross-reference book, page 242 (data/spec-sheets/Germanium_OC_crossref.pdf): OC81D row, hFE 20 min at IC 5 mA (no VCE given; the OC75's 4.5 V assumed)
